scope: Historical numerical weather forecasts verified against ERA5 reanalysis; not measured PV validation

data.location: User-configured location withheld from public artifacts
data.raw_data: Local only; no per-timestamp data or location values exported

protocol.status: Retrospective exploratory analysis of an already inspected dataset; not new independent confirmation
protocol.bootstrap: Paired circular day-block percentile intervals within each fold; fitted forecasts held fixed
protocol.uncertainty_limits: Approximate, marginal intervals; no multiple-comparison adjustment or refitting uncertainty; short within-fold dependence assumptions and artificial circular joins remain
protocol.availability: Seven-day gaps are a conservative allowance for reanalysis delivery; fixed forecast offsets do not establish exact operational release times

fixed_holdout.task: historical weather verification, not PV-power validation
fixed_holdout.variance_definition: Sample variance across all declared input models, ddof=1; squared physical units
fixed_holdout.interpretation: ERA5 is a model-based reanalysis. Lower error is agreement with ERA5, not demonstrated PV skill. The GFS comparator never enters inputs, fitting or model selection. Report all fixed comparisons without selecting a favorable reference.
